The species the habitat evidence is built for

Source: R/species.R
knw_species.Rd

link's default configuration models these eleven species, so the evidence build keeps a presence, absence and catch record per visit for each of them. char is not a species: it is the species group the FDIS code table pools bull trout, Dolly Varden and their ambiguous codes into, and a code that blocks a char absence blocks a BT absence.

Usage

knw_species()

Value

character species codes.

Examples

knw_species()
#>  [1] "BT"  "CH"  "CM"  "CO"  "GR"  "KO"  "PK"  "RB"  "SK"  "ST"  "WCT"
